description: An oil-style painting of an elderly white-bearded man in a red fez and dark frock coat bending forward to hand a folded document to a bearded man seated in a gold-framed red velvet throne. The seated man wears a dark military-style uniform with gold epaulettes and a red fez. Behind them, a crowd of men in fezzes and dark suits stands in a candlelit hall with gilded columns, a crystal chandelier, heavy drapes and framed paintings. The image fills the full area edge to edge, with a small green mark in the bottom-right corner and no readable text.
